run_connected_components: run connected components labeling on a batch of 2D boolean tensors and return dense labels with component sizes
run_connected_components_cpu: run connected components labeling on CPU using scikit-image for batched 2D tensors
run_connected_components_cpu_single: run connected components labeling on a single 2D tensor and return labels with pixel-wise component counts
build_connected_components_labels: build dense connected component labels and per-pixel size counts from a binary mask tensor
test_connected_components_cuda: test connected components on CUDA using cc_torch backend or triton fallback when cc_torch is unavailable
